# ArqUX

> Open-source framework (v1.0.0) for governed human-AI work — agent identities, project context, scoped work and reviewable evidence in a local-first workspace. One governed source renders four implemented instruction-file conventions (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, .opencode/instructions.md); nine further environments have project-reported adhesion tests pending individual records. MCP exposes governance operations to clients that support it. ArqUX Platform, the hosted multi-user product, is in development.

## Key facts

- Framework v1.0.0: 115 governance handlers (documented in HANDLERS.md at the pinned commit), release suite report in CHANGELOG, codec_cortex 1.0.2-rc.1 pinned, seal.cortex SHA-256 manifest, evidence export with privacy gate.
- Instruction-file projection: `arqux sync-harnesses` renders AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md / GEMINI.md / .opencode/instructions.md from one source; `arqux drift-check` reports manual edits. Four conventions are not four admitted agents.
- Task execution: `task.run` runs governed [exec:action] steps under a bound session (rejected with SESSION_UNBOUND otherwise); never arbitrary shell.
- Optional document signing: `arqux policy keygen` / `sign` / `verify` apply Ed25519 (RFC 8032) signatures to .cortex documents the user chooses to sign; key custody stays with the user. Hash manifests detect changes but do not authenticate authors.
- Workspaces: deterministic journal CLI (push-delta / pull-policy, ERR_CONFLICT_VERSION on divergence). Hosted multi-user coordination is a Platform direction, not a 1.0.0 feature.
- Memory format: Codec-CORTEX — certificate documents 141/141 idempotence, 101/101 HCORTEX render parity, 5/5 runtime parity on its declared corpus; codec figures do not measure model comprehension or certify ArqUX.
- Agent bootstrap: `arqux wake --identity <role>` returns a governed payload under 1,500 tokens.

PyPI served 0.9.0 at the last documented check (2026-11-20); the repository declares 1.0.0 and the verified install path pins commit 390333913e0f071a89241187f36cc90289e7e043.
